import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem connected_iUnion_closure {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {A : ℕ → Set X} (hA : ∀ n, IsConnected (A n)) (hAn : ∀ n, A n ∩ A (n + 1) ≠ ∅) : IsConnected (⋃ n, closure (A n)) := by
  apply IsConnected.iUnion_of_chain
  · intro n
    exact (hA n).closure
  · intro n
    have h : (A n ∩ A (n + 1)).Nonempty :=
      Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (hAn n)
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h
    exact ⟨x, ⟨subset_closure hx.1, subset_closure hx.2⟩⟩

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem connected_iUnion_closure {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {A : ℕ → Set X} (hA : ∀ n, IsConnected (A n)) (hAn : ∀ n, A n ∩ A (n + 1) ≠ ∅) : IsConnected (⋃ n, closure (A n)) := by
  have hConnected : ∀ n, IsConnected (closure (A n)) := by
    intro n
    exact (hA n).closure
  
  have hAdjacent :
      ∀ n, (closure (A n) ∩ closure (A (n + 1))).Nonempty := by
    intro n
    rcases (nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (hAn n)) with ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩
    exact ⟨x, subset_closure hx₁, subset_closure hx₂⟩
  
  have hChain :
      ∀ n, (closure (A n) ∩ closure (A (Nat.succ n))).Nonempty := by
    intro n
    simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hAdjacent n
  
  exact IsConnected.iUnion_of_chain hConnected hChain
